errors.evidence: The description states that the yellow sector ("Консултант/Надзор") is about 14%, but it is visually the smallest sector. The blue sector is 14.3%. The yellow sector's actual value is not labeled, but based on the other values (100 - 47.6 - 33.3 - 14.3), it should be 4.8%.
The description states that the legend is in the bottom left corner, but it is located on the right side of the pie chart.

errors.evidence: The description claims the segments are sorted in descending order, but they are not. In clockwise order, the percentages are 14.3%, 33.3%, an unlabeled small percentage (approx 4.8%), and 47.6%, which is not a sorted sequence.
